Standard 5' 10x Genomics single cell RNA sequencing protocol according to manufacturer's instructions. BCR-seq using V(D)J amplification kit.
data_processing: Demultiplexing of raw reads using cellranger mkfastq
Alignment against GRCh38 and generation of count matrices using cellranger count
Assembly: GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: count matrix, barcode list, feature list in csv file format and QC file in html format for gene expression (GEX)

Supplementary files format and content: High-level descriptions of each clonotype, high-level and detailed annotations of each clonotype consensus sequence, high-level annotations of each high-confidence contigs from cell-associated barcodes, and high-level and detailed annotations of all contigs (from cell and background barcodes) in csv file format and QC file in html format for B cell receptor sequencing (BCR)

metadata.source_identity_policy: Exact original P-codes link source stages within participants.30participant-stage groups from22source participants have31RNA views; P9 HC-MBL replicate remains dependent on its primary view, not an extra blood draw.
metadata.source_selection_policy: Primary publication explicitly reports CD19-enriched peripheral blood. Source GEO describes mononuclear density isolation. Selected composition is not unsorted whole PBMC composition; missing other lineages are not measured zero.
metadata.source_stage_policy: Original LC-MBL/HC-MBL/CLL source labels retained. Same-participant HC-MBL and CLL records are linked observations. Exact individual sampling dates and intervals not inferred from group medians or filename numbers.
metadata.source_demographic_policy: Primary table reports age at diagnosis; that is not substituted for age at blood draw. Individual draw age/sex not yet joined into this processing phase.
metadata.source_coverage_policy: RNA only; related ATAC and other molecular assays are not additional RNA samples. Primary publication cohort totals include source participants absent from this RNA release.
metadata.split_assignment: unassigned; no discovery model or donor split fitted

source_count_review.barcode_scope: Source matrix barcode rows; not automatically called or viable cells
